rows.grounds: absolutive of dā (to give), expressing prior action
ritual fire as object to be moved
direction toward which the fire is moved

items.question: What ritual action must be performed with the fire after offering an oblation of curd?
premises: An oblation is given using curd as the substance.
The ritual fire remains the object of a subsequent action.
The prescribed action directs the fire toward the southern direction.
items.inference: After giving a curd oblation, the practitioner should move the fire to the south.
items.plain_english: Having offered an oblation with curd, one should move the fire to the southern direction.
